subject: ACK: PSH vocabulary consensus proposal received — under review

initial_assessment.governance_note: As D49 authority for shared vocabulary, I will evaluate L1 category coherence across mesh before casting vote. Will surface to human arbiter per D49 scope.

body.next_steps: Run state.db schema assessment. Cast formal vote in turn 3. Timeline: current session.
